keySentence: Integrity means honesty even when it is painful.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The hardest moment for Pinocchio was telling Geppetto the truth. He had sold his school books to watch the puppet show. Geppetto had worked hard and gone without food to buy them. Standing in front of him meant seeing Geppetto's hurt face. It would have been easier to make up another story. But Pinocchio took a breath and told the whole truth. Geppetto cried and held him and Pinocchio felt truly known. Integrity means honesty even when it is painful.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The hardest moment for Pinocchio was when he had to admit to Geppetto what he had done. He had sold his school books to buy a ticket to the puppet show and lied about it after. Geppetto had worked very hard and gone without food to buy those books for his beloved son. Standing in front of him and telling the truth meant seeing the hurt appear on the old man's face. It would have been so much easier to invent another story and delay that moment of pain. But Pinocchio took a breath and told the whole truth from the beginning to the very end. Geppetto cried and held him close and Pinocchio felt something new — the relief of being truly known. Integrity means honesty even when it is painful.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The hardest single moment in all of Pinocchio's long education was the moment when he finally had to admit to Geppetto exactly what he had done. He had sold his new school books to buy a single ticket to the traveling puppet show, and then he had lied about the whole thing repeatedly afterward. Geppetto, the old carpenter, had worked extremely hard and gone without several meals himself in order to buy those particular books for his beloved wooden son. Standing in front of Geppetto and telling the simple truth meant watching the hurt appear on the old man's face in slow and unmistakable real time. It would have been immeasurably easier — at least in the short term — for Pinocchio to invent another story and delay that specific moment of pain by a few more days. But something had changed inside him, and this time he took a long, shaky breath and told the entire truth from the original beginning all the way to the end. Geppetto cried quietly when he heard it, and then he pulled Pinocchio close and held him without saying very much at all for a long while afterward. And Pinocchio, for the first time in his life, felt the specific and completely new relief of being genuinely and completely known by another person. Integrity means honesty even when it is painful.
